meta.name: mtls-configuration
meta.description: Configure mutual TLS (mTLS) for zero-trust service-to-service communication. Use when implementing zero-trust networking, certificate management, or securing internal service communication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置服务间双向 TLS 认证,建立零信任安全通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在服务之间启用相互 TLS 认证来加固通信安全
copy.tagline_en: Configure mutual TLS for services to enable zero-trust communication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to secure internal service communication with mTLS.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按原文给出的流程指导你配置服务间双向 TLS(mTLS):先梳理 Root CA、中间 CA 到工作负载证书的层级,再走 TLS 握手与双向证书校验,并给出证书轮换与排错的注意事项。
howto.when: 当你实施零信任网络、做证书管理与轮换,或需要加固内部服务通信时触发;原文也覆盖排查 TLS 握手失败与合规要求等场景。

say.text: 帮我为服务 A 和服务 B 之间的通信配置 mTLS
say.note: 会按证书层级和握手流程给出配置步骤

say.text: 帮我规划 CA 和证书的轮换方式
say.note: 会说明短周期证书与轮换注意事项

say.text: 帮我排查一个 TLS 握手失败的问题
say.note: 会从证书链校验等角度分析

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude walks you through configuring mutual TLS (mTLS) between services: it lays out the Root CA, intermediate CA and workload certificate hierarchy, the TLS handshake with two-way certificate verification, plus notes on rotation and debugging.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement zero-trust networking, handle certificate management and rotation, or harden internal service communication; it also covers TLS handshake debugging and compliance needs.

say_en.text: Help me configure mTLS between service A and service B
say_en.note: Gives config steps following the cert hierarchy and handshake

say_en.text: Help me plan CA and certificate rotation
say_en.note: Explains short-lived certs and rotation notes

say_en.text: Help me debug a failed TLS handshake
say_en.note: Analyzes from the certificate chain angle
